ModMetaData.name: HSK Weapon Blueprints
ModMetaData.author: Sonsalt
ModMetaData.description:
HSK Weapon Blueprints (0.1, test release): weapons have to be learned before they can be crafted.
Researching a technology no longer unlocks every gun at once. Each Industrial or higher weapon (guns, melee weapons and grenades) needs a blueprint or a successful reverse engineering before its crafting bill appears. Unlocks are permanent and colony-wide. Workbench menus only list the weapons you know, which keeps big weapon packs tidy.
Blueprints - Book-like items, one per weapon, sold by traders and found in quest rewards and ancient ruins. Rarer and pricier for valuable and high-tech weapons. - Pawns study them while reading for recreation, or as Research work. Intellectual skill speeds this up; there is no minimum skill. - Study progress is shared by the colony. Once a weapon is learned the blueprint can be sold.
Reverse engineering - A "Reverse engineer weapon" bill at the benches that craft weapons. - Chance from Crafting + Intellectual skill, lower for high-tech weapons. - Success teaches the weapon and uses up the weapon. Failure damages it or destroys it.
Works automatically with weapon mods (by tech level). Built for Hardcore SK and Combat Extended on RimWorld 1.7.
Requires a new colony. Adding it to an existing save locks every gated weapon in that save.
